cultist.name: Serpent Eye Cultist
cultist.description: A fanatical follower of the Serpent Eye cult, wielding simple weapons and chanting dark prayers.

cultist_elite.name: Elite Serpent Eye Cultist
cultist_elite.description: A veteran cultist, better armed and armored than their lesser brethren, displaying unwavering devotion.

cultist_fanatic.name: Serpent Eye Fanatic
cultist_fanatic.description: A wild-eyed cultist driven mad by devotion, fighting with supernatural fervor and feeling no pain.

cultist_sorcerer.name: Cult Sorcerer
cultist_sorcerer.description: A robed cultist who has mastered minor magical powers through dark pacts, able to cast low-level spells.
cultist_sorcerer.special_attacks: Can cast magic missile, sleep, and shield

cult_pyromancer_transformed.name: Transformed Pyromancer
cult_pyromancer_transformed.description: A cultist whose body has been warped by elemental fire, wreathed in flames and immune to heat.

cult_hydromancer_transformed.name: Transformed Hydromancer
cult_hydromancer_transformed.description: A cultist transformed by water magic, their skin blue and scaled, able to breathe underwater and summon freezing sprays.
cult_hydromancer_transformed.special_attacks: Can spray frost for 1d8 cold damage

cult_geomancer_transformed.name: Transformed Geomancer
cult_geomancer_transformed.description: A cultist whose flesh has turned to living stone, tremendously strong and nearly impervious to normal weapons.
cult_geomancer_transformed.special_defenses: Takes half damage from non-magical weapons

cult_aeromancer_transformed.name: Transformed Aeromancer
cult_aeromancer_transformed.description: A cultist infused with air magic, able to levitate and hurl bolts of lightning, their body crackling with static.

high_priest_defender.name: High Priest Defender
high_priest_defender.description: An elite guardian priest of the Serpent Eye cult, clad in dark robes and wielding powerful divine magic.

high_priest_korvash.name: High Priest Korvash
high_priest_korvash.description: A powerful high priest of the cult, able to command both the living and the dead with dark divine authority.
high_priest_korvash.special_attacks: 8th level cleric spells, can command undead

morvathis_high_priest.name: High Priest Morvathis
morvathis_high_priest.description: The supreme high priest of the Serpent Eye cult, possessing terrifying magical power and able to transform into a giant serpent.
morvathis_high_priest.special_attacks: 9th level cleric spells, can transform into giant serpent (10 HD, 3d8 damage)
morvathis_high_priest.special_defenses: 20% magic resistance, +3 or better weapons to hit

valerius_krane.name: Valerius Krane, Cult Leader
valerius_krane.description: The charismatic founder and absolute leader of the Serpent Eye cult, a master of both arcane and divine magic.
valerius_krane.special_attacks: Can cast both 8th level magic-user spells AND 8th level cleric spells. Two attacks per round.
valerius_krane.special_defenses: 30% magic resistance, regenerates 3 HP per round, +3 or better weapons to hit

barbed_devil.name: Barbed Devil (Hamatula)
barbed_devil.description: A towering devil covered in razor-sharp barbs, radiating an aura of terror and able to impale foes in a deadly embrace.
barbed_devil.special_attacks: Fear aura (save vs spell or flee), barbed embrace (2d6 additional damage if both attacks hit)
barbed_devil.special_defenses: 40% magic resistance, +1 or better weapons to hit, regenerates 1 HP/round

elemental_herald.name: Elemental Herald
elemental_herald.description: A being of pure elemental power, able to command all four elements and summon lesser elementals to its aid.
elemental_herald.special_attacks: Can summon 1d4 lesser elementals once per day, elemental attacks (fire/cold/acid/lightning)
elemental_herald.special_defenses: 30% magic resistance, immune to one elemental type (varies), +2 or better weapons to hit

fire_elemental.name: Fire Elemental
fire_elemental.description: A churning mass of living flame, radiating intense heat and able to ignite anything it touches.
fire_elemental.special_defenses: Immune to fire damage, takes double damage from water/cold

water_elemental.name: Water Elemental
water_elemental.description: A swirling vortex of living water, able to engulf and drown its victims in its liquid form.
water_elemental.special_attacks: Can attempt to engulf and drown opponents (save vs paralysis or take 2d8 damage/round)
water_elemental.special_defenses: Immune to water damage, takes double damage from fire

earth_elemental.name: Earth Elemental
earth_elemental.description: A hulking mass of animated earth and stone, tremendously strong and nearly impervious to physical harm.
earth_elemental.special_attacks: Can move through earth and stone at will
earth_elemental.special_defenses: Immune to earth/stone attacks, takes double damage from air/wind magic

air_elemental.name: Air Elemental
air_elemental.description: An invisible whirlwind of sentient air, nearly impossible to see and able to create devastating windstorms.
air_elemental.special_attacks: Whirlwind form can sweep up opponents (save vs breath weapon or take 3d6 damage and be flung)
air_elemental.special_defenses: Immune to air/wind attacks, difficult to see (-2 to hit), takes double damage from earth magic

serpents_voice.name: The Serpent's Voice
serpents_voice.description: A mysterious entity claiming to speak for the Serpent God, able to control minds and summon serpents from the void.
serpents_voice.special_attacks: Mind control (save vs spell -2 or be dominated for 1d6 rounds), summon 1d4 giant serpents
serpents_voice.special_defenses: 50% magic resistance, telepathy, +2 or better weapons to hit

summoned_demon.name: Summoned Demon (Vrock)
summoned_demon.description: A vulture-headed demon summoned from the Abyss, able to fly and release deadly spore clouds.
summoned_demon.special_attacks: Spore cloud (once per day, 15 foot radius, save vs poison or take 1d8 damage and be stunned for 1 round)
summoned_demon.special_defenses: 50% magic resistance, +1 or better weapons to hit, can teleport without error

duergar.name: Duergar (Gray Dwarf)
duergar.description: A gray-skinned dwarf from the Underdark, able to turn invisible and grow to giant size.
duergar.special_attacks: Can turn invisible or enlarge self (once per day each)

duergar_elite.name: Duergar Elite Guard
duergar_elite.description: A veteran duergar warrior, better equipped and more skilled in their innate magical abilities.
duergar_elite.special_attacks: Can turn invisible or enlarge self (twice per day each)

grathak_the_soulless.name: Grathak the Soulless
grathak_the_soulless.description: A legendary duergar necromancer who sold his soul for power, now able to command the undead and drain the life from his foes.
grathak_the_soulless.special_attacks: Soul drain (touch drains 1 level), can command undead, 7th level magic-user spells
grathak_the_soulless.special_defenses: 30% magic resistance, can turn invisible or enlarge (at will)

cult_general_malakar.name: General Malakar
cult_general_malakar.description: The supreme military commander of the Serpent Eye cult, a legendary warrior whose presence inspires fanatical devotion.
cult_general_malakar.special_attacks: Three attacks per round, all allies within 30 feet gain +2 to morale and attack rolls
cult_general_malakar.special_defenses: Battle fury (when below 25% HP, gains +4 to attack and damage)

marsh_zombie.name: Marsh Zombie
marsh_zombie.description: A waterlogged corpse animated by dark magic, shambling from the swamps with diseased claws.
marsh_zombie.special_attacks: Diseased touch (save vs poison or contract marsh fever)
marsh_zombie.special_defenses: Immune to poison, sleep, charm, hold

sahuagin.name: Sahuagin (Sea Devil)
sahuagin.description: A shark-like humanoid from the depths, able to breathe underwater and driven into a frenzy by the scent of blood.
sahuagin.special_attacks: Blood frenzy (if any opponent is bloodied, gains +1 to attack and damage)

giant_octopus.name: Giant Octopus
giant_octopus.description: A massive octopus with tentacles thick as tree trunks, able to constrict prey and release blinding ink clouds.
giant_octopus.special_attacks: Constriction (any hit with tentacle grapples, dealing 2d6 automatic damage per round). Ink cloud (once per day, 20 foot radius, blinds for 1d6 rounds)

cultist_diver.name: Cultist Diver
cultist_diver.description: A cultist equipped with magical water-breathing gear, able to operate underwater to guard the cult's submerged facilities.

aboleth_spawn.name: Aboleth Spawn
aboleth_spawn.description: A lesser aboleth, a fish-like creature with three eyes and four tentacles, able to enslave minds and secrete enslaving mucus.
aboleth_spawn.special_attacks: Enslavement (save vs spell or be dominated permanently). Mucus cloud (any creature within 10 feet must save vs poison or lose ability to breathe air for 3 hours - can only breathe water)

silas_bodyguard.name: Silas's Bodyguard
silas_bodyguard.description: An elite mercenary hired to protect the cult lieutenant Silas, trained to intercept attacks and defend their charge.
silas_bodyguard.special_attacks: Can intercept one attack per round against Silas (if within 10 feet)

grukk_hobgoblin_chief.name: Grukk, Hobgoblin Chieftain
grukk_hobgoblin_chief.description: A cunning hobgoblin warlord allied with the cult, leading his tribe with brutal efficiency and tactical brilliance.
grukk_hobgoblin_chief.special_attacks: All hobgoblins within 30 feet gain +1 to attack and morale. Two attacks per round.

bloodfang_orc.name: Bloodfang Orc Warrior
bloodfang_orc.description: A member of the fearsome Bloodfang orc tribe, known for their red war paint and savage battle fury.
bloodfang_orc.special_attacks: Blood rage (when below 50% HP, gains +2 to damage)

cultist_scribe.name: Cult Scribe
cultist_scribe.description: A scholarly cultist who transcribes dark rituals and maintains the cult's records. Weak in combat but holds valuable knowledge.

cultist_torturer.name: Cult Torturer
cultist_torturer.description: A brutal cultist who specializes in extracting information and breaking the will of prisoners through pain.

merchant_guard.name: Merchant Guard
merchant_guard.description: A professional hired guard in Silas's employ. Better trained and equipped than common thugs, these guards are loyal to coin rather than the cult. They wear leather armor and wield longswords with competence.

warehouse_foreman.name: Warehouse Foreman
warehouse_foreman.description: A burly, scarred overseer who runs Silas's warehouse operations with an iron fist. Armed with a heavy club and wearing studded leather, he's both tough and mean. His presence bolsters nearby workers and guards.

silas_bodyguard.name: Silas's Elite Bodyguard
silas_bodyguard.description: Silas's personal bodyguards are elite fighters, handpicked for skill and loyalty. They wear chain mail and wield longswords with deadly precision. They will fight to the death to protect their employer.
silas_bodyguard.special_attacks: Shield wall (AC bonus of +1 when fighting alongside another bodyguard)

cursed_construct.name: Cursed Construct
cursed_construct.description: An animated suit of armor possessed by dark magic and cursed spirits. Created in Silas's ritual workshop to guard the most dangerous items. Its eyes glow with malevolent red light, and cursed energy crackles around it. Only magical weapons can harm it.
cursed_construct.special_attacks: Curse aura (targets within 10ft must save vs. spell or suffer -1 to attack rolls)

bound_demon.name: Bound Demon
bound_demon.description: A lesser demon partially bound by the cult's rituals. Though chained to the binding chamber, it can still attack those who enter. Its form is grotesque—horned, clawed, and wreathed in sulfurous smoke. The binding is weakening; it yearns for freedom and vengeance. Its very presence inspires terror.
bound_demon.special_attacks: Fear aura (targets within 20ft must save vs. spell or flee for 1d4 rounds), fire breath (3d6 damage, usable once per 3 rounds)

duergar_cleric.name: Duergar Dark Priest
duergar_cleric.description: Duergar clerics who worship both the traditional duergar gods and the Serpent Eye cult. They can cast dark divine spells and perform serpent rituals. Their prayers are guttural chants in the language of the Underdark, and they command undead rather than turning them. Utterly devoted to spreading the cult's influence.
duergar_cleric.special_attacks: Can cast cleric spells (3rd level). Can command undead. Can turn invisible once per day.

duergar_slaver.name: Duergar Slaver
duergar_slaver.description: Cruel duergar who specialize in capturing, breaking, and selling slaves. They carry spiked chains and barbed whips, instruments designed to inflict pain without killing. Masters of psychological torture, they take perverse pleasure in breaking the spirits of their captives. Feared throughout the Underdark.
duergar_slaver.special_attacks: Attacks with spiked chain (can entangle on hit, target must save vs. paralysis or be restrained). Can turn invisible once per day.

corrupted_dwarf.name: Mind-Controlled Dwarf
corrupted_dwarf.description: Captured dwarves whose minds have been shattered by dark magic and serpent cult rituals. Their eyes glow with an eerie serpent-green light, and they fight with mindless ferocity. They feel no fear, no pain, only the compulsion to obey their duergar masters. A tragic fate—these were once proud warriors of Ironfast. Killing them may be a mercy.
corrupted_dwarf.special_attacks: Immune to fear and morale effects. Fights to the death with no sense of self-preservation.

cave_troll.name: Cave Troll
cave_troll.description: A massive troll adapted to life in deep caves and the Underdark. Standing 9 feet tall with gray-green skin and long claws, it regenerates wounds at an alarming rate unless burned or dissolved in acid. The duergar have trained these beasts as war creatures. It attacks with two claws and a vicious bite. Fearsome and relentless, though it fears fire intensely.
cave_troll.special_attacks: Regenerates 3 HP per round (negated by fire or acid). If both claws hit, can rend for additional 2d6 damage.

cultist_ritualist.name: Serpent Eye Ritualist
cultist_ritualist.description: Scholar-cultists who have learned the basics of serpent magic. They wear dark robes inscribed with serpent runes and carry ritual daggers. Weaker in direct combat than warriors, but dangerous with their spells. They can cast minor curses, summon serpent spirits, and create areas of darkness. Often found translating ancient texts or preparing rituals.
cultist_ritualist.special_attacks: Can cast 1-2 first level spells per day (darkness, cause fear, detect magic). +2 to all serpent cult ritual checks.

serpent_priest.name: Serpent Priest
serpent_priest.description: Mid-ranking priests of the Serpent Eye cult. They wear elaborate serpent-scale armor and ceremonial headdresses shaped like cobra hoods. Wielding dark magic and serpent-blessed weapons, they lead rituals and command lesser cultists. Their serpent tattoos writhe with life during spellcasting. They can summon serpents, inflict curses, and heal cultist allies with dark rituals.
serpent_priest.special_attacks: Can cast 2-3 cleric spells per day (levels 1-2). Can command serpents within 60 feet. Inflict curse once per day.

temple_guardian.name: Stone Serpent Guardian
temple_guardian.description: Animated stone statues carved in the shape of coiled serpents. Standing 10 feet tall, these ancient guardians were created by long-dead temple priests to protect sacred areas. Their stone bodies make them nearly impervious to normal weapons. Green light glows from their carved eyes as they animate to crush intruders. They feel no pain, no fear, and cannot be reasoned with—only destroyed.
temple_guardian.special_attacks: Immune to poison, disease, mind-affecting magic. Takes half damage from non-magical weapons. Attacks with crushing stone coils (2d6 damage).

marsh_troll.name: Marsh Troll
marsh_troll.description: A variant troll adapted to marsh environments. Its skin is mottled green and gray, covered in moss and algae. It regenerates wounds at an alarming rate unless damaged by fire or acid. Marsh trolls are cunning hunters who lurk in flooded areas, grabbing prey and dragging them underwater. They reek of rot and swamp gas. Their claws carry marsh diseases from the filth they dwell in.
marsh_troll.special_attacks: Regenerates 3 HP per round (fire and acid prevent regeneration). Claw attacks can inflict marsh fever (save vs. poison or contract disease). Can fight underwater without penalty.

swamp_wraith.name: Swamp Wraith
swamp_wraith.description: Malevolent spirits of those who died in the marshes—drowned, murdered, or sacrificed. They appear as translucent, ghostly figures shrouded in mist and marsh gas. Their touch drains life energy, leaving victims weakened and cold. Swamp wraiths are tied to the locations of their deaths, unable to rest. They hate the living with burning intensity. Only magic weapons can harm their incorporeal forms.
swamp_wraith.special_attacks: Touch drains 1 level/hit dice (permanent until restoration magic). Incorporeal (immune to normal weapons, takes half damage from magical weapons). Cannot enter sunlight (takes 1d6 damage per round).

ash_wraith.name: Ash Wraith
ash_wraith.description: A spectral remnant formed from victims of volcanic eruptions, wreathed in hot ash and smoke, draining the life force of the living.
ash_wraith.special_defenses: Incorporeal: half damage from normal weapons, fire immunity

cultist_pyromancer.name: Cultist Pyromancer
cultist_pyromancer.description: A cultist specialized in fire magic, channeling volcanic energies to immolate enemies. Wears flame-resistant robes and carries a staff crowned with ever-burning flames.

lava_serpent.name: Lava Serpent
lava_serpent.description: A massive serpent that dwells in volcanic lava flows, its scales glowing red-hot. Its bite delivers both crushing damage and superheated venom.
lava_serpent.special_attacks: Poison: Save vs poison or take 2d6 additional fire damage over 3 rounds
lava_serpent.special_defenses: Fire immunity, heat aura deals 1d4 fire damage to melee attackers

magma_elemental.name: Magma Elemental
magma_elemental.description: A massive elemental creature formed from molten lava and volcanic rock, combining the fury of fire with the crushing weight of stone. Extremely dangerous and nearly impossible to harm with normal weapons.
magma_elemental.special_attacks: Ignite: flammable items must save or catch fire, Lava flow: can create difficult terrain
magma_elemental.special_defenses: Fire immunity, can only be hit by +1 or better weapons

drowned_spirit.name: Drowned Spirit
drowned_spirit.description: The tortured spirit of a citizen of Ys'Thara, drowned when the city sank. These wraiths haunt their former homes, unable to accept their fate.
drowned_spirit.special_attacks: Touch drains 1 level (save vs paralysis negates)
drowned_spirit.special_defenses: Incorporeal (half damage from non-magical weapons), immune to cold and poison

animated_armor.name: Animated Armor
animated_armor.description: A suit of ornate plate armor animated by protective enchantments. It guards its lord's treasures even after death.
animated_armor.special_defenses: Immune to mind-affecting effects, poison, and disease

cultist_foreman.name: Cultist Foreman
cultist_foreman.description: A tough, experienced cultist who oversees underwater excavation operations. Commands respect and obedience from lesser cultists.
cultist_foreman.special_attacks: Grants +1 to hit and morale to nearby allies

mind_controlled_diver.name: Mind-Controlled Diver
mind_controlled_diver.description: A former fisherman or diver whose mind has been enslaved by the aboleth. They fight without fear or mercy, trapped in their own body.
mind_controlled_diver.special_defenses: Immune to fear and morale checks (enslaved)

sahuagin_chieftain.name: Sahuagin Chieftain
sahuagin_chieftain.description: The leader of a sahuagin war band. Larger and stronger than typical sahuagin, with ceremonial scars and trophies from defeated enemies.
sahuagin_chieftain.special_attacks: Can summon 1d4 sharks once per day, grants +2 morale to sahuagin allies

cultist_guard.name: Cultist Guard
cultist_guard.description: A cult warrior assigned to guard contraband and valuable artifacts. Better equipped and trained than typical cultists.

giant_crab.name: Giant Crab
giant_crab.description: A massive crab with thick shell armor and crushing pincers. Common in underwater ruins where they make lairs.
giant_crab.special_attacks: On hit with both pincers (20), automatically grabs and crushes for 2d6 damage per round

stone_golem_guardian.name: Stone Golem Guardian
stone_golem_guardian.description: An ancient stone golem crafted by royal wizards to guard the throne of Ys'Thara. Immensely powerful and nearly indestructible.
stone_golem_guardian.special_attacks: Slow spell effect in 10-foot radius (save vs spell or move at half speed for 2d6 rounds)
stone_golem_guardian.special_defenses: Can only be hit by +2 or better weapons. Immune to most spells (only Move Earth, Earthquake, Transmute Rock to Mud, and similar affect it)

aboleth_ancient.name: Ancient Aboleth
aboleth_ancient.description: An ancient aboleth, the creature that destroyed Ys'Thara. Its psychic power is immense, and it has enslaved countless victims over the centuries. This optional boss is extremely dangerous.
aboleth_ancient.special_attacks: Enslavement (save vs spell at -2 or be dominated permanently). Mucus cloud (30-foot radius: save vs poison or lose air-breathing for 4 hours). Psionics (domination, mind blast, psychic crush)
aboleth_ancient.special_defenses: Waterbreathing, telepathy (1000-foot range), can create illusions at will

skeleton_champion.name: Skeleton Champion
skeleton_champion.description: An elite skeletal warrior, armored and wielding masterwork weapons. These are the remains of ancient champions, reanimated to serve their dark master.
skeleton_champion.special_attacks: Can command lesser skeletons (1-4 skeletons follow champion)
skeleton_champion.special_defenses: Undead immunities (poison, charm, sleep, hold), half damage from slashing/piercing, immune to cold

mummy_guardian.name: Mummy Guardian
mummy_guardian.description: An ancient mummy bound to guard treasure vaults. More powerful than common mummies, these elite guardians were priests or warriors in life.
mummy_guardian.special_attacks: Mummy rot (touch causes disease, -2 to hit, half healing, fatal in 1d6 months without cure disease). Fear aura (save vs spell or flee for 1d4 rounds)
mummy_guardian.special_defenses: Undead immunities, magic weapons required to hit, fire damage only (immune to normal weapons)

cultist_warrior.name: Cultist Warrior
cultist_warrior.description: A trained cult soldier, equipped with quality weapons and armor. These warriors have abandoned their former lives to serve the cult full-time.

cultist_archer.name: Cultist Archer
cultist_archer.description: A cult member trained in ranged combat. Archers provide cover fire for melee warriors and pick off targets from range.
cultist_archer.special_attacks: Longbow attack (60/120/180 range, 2 attacks per round)

cultist_sergeant.name: Cultist Sergeant
cultist_sergeant.description: A veteran cult warrior who commands guards and soldiers. Sergeants are battle-hardened leaders with years of experience.
cultist_sergeant.special_attacks: Command presence (allies within 30 feet gain +1 to morale and attack rolls)

cultist_quartermaster.name: Cultist Quartermaster
cultist_quartermaster.description: The cult's supply master, responsible for logistics and equipment. Not as combat-focused as warriors, but cunning and resourceful.
cultist_quartermaster.special_attacks: Can summon 1d4 cultist guards as reinforcements
cultist_quartermaster.special_defenses: Has escape route planned (25% chance to flee successfully)

imp_advisor.name: Imp Advisor
imp_advisor.description: A slightly more powerful imp that serves Krane as an advisor and spy. These devils have enhanced intelligence and cunning.
imp_advisor.special_attacks: Poison sting (save vs poison or take 1 hp damage per round for 1d4 rounds). Can cast detect magic, invisibility at will
imp_advisor.special_defenses: Regenerate 1 hp/round, immune to fire and poison, magic weapons required to hit, can become invisible

flesh_golem.name: Flesh Golem
flesh_golem.description: An alchemical construct of stitched corpses, animated by dark magic. This creation of Krane's experiments is a mindless killing machine.
flesh_golem.special_attacks: Berserk (10% chance per round of going berserk, attacking nearest creature friend or foe)
flesh_golem.special_defenses: Immune to mind-affecting, poison, disease. Only hit by +1 or better weapons. Immune to lightning (heals 1 hp per die of damage). Fire and cold do half damage

mutated_cultist.name: Mutated Cultist
mutated_cultist.description: A failed alchemical experiment. Once human, now twisted by dark magic and mutagenic potions. Deformed, insane, and dangerously unpredictable.
mutated_cultist.special_attacks: Claw/claw attacks, can't be reasoned with (insane)
mutated_cultist.special_defenses: Resist poison (saves at +4), regenerate 1 hp per round

bearded_devil.name: Bearded Devil (Barbazu)
bearded_devil.description: An infernal warrior from the Nine Hells. Bearded devils are savage fighters with faces covered in writhing, venomous tendrils.
bearded_devil.special_attacks: Glaive attack (2d4 damage) + beard tentacles (1d4 + infernal wound: bleeding 1 hp/round unless cure spell or healing potion). Can summon another bearded devil 30% chance
bearded_devil.special_defenses: Immune to fire and poison. Magic weapons required to hit. Regenerate 1 hp/round. Telepathy 100 feet

lemure.name: Lemure
lemure.description: The lowest form of devil—a blob of damned souls melted together. Mindless, slow, but relentless. These are the currency of Hell.
lemure.special_defenses: Immune to fire, poison, charm, sleep, hold. Regenerate 1 hp/round. Magic weapons required to hit. Can only be permanently destroyed by holy water

storm_elemental.name: Storm Elemental
storm_elemental.description: A fusion of air and water elementals, manifesting as a violent thunderstorm given sentience. Lightning arcs through rain and wind, striking at intruders.
storm_elemental.special_attacks: Lightning strike (3d6 damage, save vs breath for half)
storm_elemental.special_defenses: Immune to lightning and cold, +1 or better weapon to hit

chaos_spawn.name: Chaos Spawn
chaos_spawn.description: A creature born from the raw chaos of the Elemental Chaos. Its form constantly shifts—sometimes humanoid, sometimes bestial, sometimes geometric impossibilities. Reality bends around it.
chaos_spawn.special_attacks: Reality distortion: target must save vs spell or be confused for 1d4 rounds
chaos_spawn.special_defenses: 20% magic resistance, form changes grant +2 AC bonus randomly

elemental_guardian.name: Elemental Guardian
elemental_guardian.description: A construct of stone and metal infused with elemental power, created by the cult to guard the keystones. It cannot be reasoned with, bribed, or intimidated—it exists only to destroy intruders.
elemental_guardian.special_defenses: Immune to mind-affecting spells, 50% magic resistance, +2 or better weapon to hit

cultist_elementalist.name: Cultist Elementalist
cultist_elementalist.description: A cultist in the early stages of elemental transformation. Their skin shows patches of stone, flame, water, or wind. They can cast minor elemental spells but haven't yet lost their humanity.
cultist_elementalist.special_attacks: Can cast burning hands or shocking grasp 3/day
cultist_elementalist.special_defenses: Partial resistance to one element (takes half damage)

primal_wisp.name: Primal Wisp
primal_wisp.description: A fragment of elemental energy given minimal sentience. Wisps drift through the Elemental Chaos, sometimes attacking intruders, sometimes fleeing. They appear as glowing orbs of fire, water, air, or earth.

thug.name: Thug
thug.description: A common criminal enforcer or hired muscle, skilled with clubs and daggers.

silas_merchant.name: Silas the Corrupt Merchant
silas_merchant.description: A wealthy merchant corrupted by the cult, Silas uses his resources and connections to further the serpent cult's goals. He fights with a poisoned dagger and tactical cunning.

grathak_soulless.name: Grathak the Soulless
grathak_soulless.treasure_type: Q, X, magic weapon, magic armor
grathak_soulless.description: The soulless duergar chieftain who sold his people to the cult. Grathak wields dark magic and a massive warhammer, and can turn invisible like all duergar.
